note: widget-preview renders a bound ui:// widget PLUS this project's live payload into one self-contained file under .marvin/preview/ and opens it, which is the escape hatch for hosts that cannot resolve _meta.ui.resourceUri — the Claude Code CLI among them (ADR-0034). Its two nearest neighbours, /marvin:dashboard and /marvin:help, are prompts with no SKILL.md and so are absent from the catalog a decider is shown; they cannot be competition winners and appear in negative notes instead. The distinction to measure is SEEING a widget rendered versus reading the same data as terminal text, and previewing a widget versus changing one.
